rationale: The short thesis remains intact as ERO recently broke below the prior session low of $21.75 to set a new low of $21.72 on elevated volume (73,625 shares on the 1-minute breakdown bar), while trading below both the descending 5-minute 9-EMA ($21.94) and session VWAP ($22.26). The current bounce toward $21.84–$21.89 is occurring on drastically lower volume (1,528 shares on the latest bar) while the broader market remains deeply negative (SPY -2.74%). With 63 minutes left in the session and a wide 32.0 bps spread, holding allows the existing downtrend to resume toward the $21.65 target without paying a wide spread on a weak pullback.
